description: Rutas de bicicleta de la red EuroVelo en España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Spanish stages of the large European network of long-distance cycle routes promoted by the European Cyclists' Federation (ECF), run by ConBici, the EuroVelo coordinator in Spain. Coverage: Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). The portal shows the English title as "EuroVelo network cycling routes in Spain" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Centro Nacional de Información Geográfica (CNIG). Its keywords include Rutas, Bicicleta. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
